title: Seniors page
intro: Simple help: call a trusted person right away and see or share where you are.
phoneNote: The number stays saved on this phone.
consentText: To find where you are, the phone will ask to use your exact location. Press OK to continue.

error.denied: Location was not allowed. Enable it in your browser settings and try again.
error.unavailable: This device cannot find the location.
error.generic: Cannot find the location. Try again outdoors.
